in_sanskrit.name: रेणु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Renu is derived from the Sanskrit word रेणु (Renu) which means 'lotus'. The lotus is a sacred flower in Hinduism and symbolizes purity, enlightenment, and rebirth.

in_hindi.name: रेणु
in_hindi.long_meaning: रेणु एक प्रकृतिक नाम है जिसमें संस्कृत शब्द रेणु से उत्पन्न होता है। यह शब्द लोतुस का अर्थ है। लोतुस एक पवित्र फूल है जिससे पुनर्भव, प्रकृति और तत्वज्ञान के सिंबल हैं।

in_tamil.name: ரேனு
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Renu in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word रेणु (Renu), which means 'lotus'. The lotus is considered a sacred flower in Tamil culture and symbolizes purity, beauty, and grace.

in_telugu.name: రెను
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Renu in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word रेणु (Renu), which means 'lotus'. In Telugu culture, the lotus is considered a sacred symbol of Lord Vishnu and represents purity, love, and divinity.

in_marathi.name: Renu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Name of a goddess representing wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Renu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Renu means 'a drop' or 'a grain'. It is also the name of a goddess representing wealth and prosperity. In Hinduism, Renu is a symbol of renewal and rejuvenation, and is often invoked during rituals and ceremonies for the sake of good luck and abundance.

vedic_reference.note: The name Renu is derived from the Sanskrit word रेणु (Renu), which is used in various Vedic texts to refer to the lotus flower and its symbolic significance. For example, in the Rigveda (10.129.5), the lotus is described as the 'king of flowers' (पतलपत्रमस्तु विद्धि पुष्पम्, patalapatramastu viddhi pushpam), emphasizing its importance and sacredness in Hinduism.
